_comment: Ratchet for `vox audit --gate all --strict-block-ga --ga-baseline <this>` (cr-l-gates.yml). Gates listed here are KNOWN unmet toward v1.0; CI fails only when any other GA gate is unmet (a regression). The snapshot's `ga_met` stays the honest v1.0 verdict: no 'v1.0 ready' claim while this list is non-empty. Remove a gate as soon as it is met (the audit prints which); never add one to make CI green, fix the regression instead. Measured on main 2026-10-09 (run 37864021083).
